universities.name: Technical University of Munich (TUM)
universities.description: One of Europe's top technical universities, renowned for computer science, robotics, data engineering, and management.
universities.englishRequirementSummary: IELTS 6.5 - 7.0 or TOEFL 88+. Requires APS certificate for Pakistani degrees.

programs.title: M.Sc. Informatics (Computer Science)
programs.notes: Strict aptitude assessment based on bachelor mathematics and computer architecture credits. APS certificate mandatory.

programs.title: M.Sc. Data Engineering and Analytics
programs.notes: High mathematics prerequisite; requires verified syllabus matching.

universities.name: RWTH Aachen University
universities.description: The largest technical university in Germany, globally respected for Mechanical, Electrical, Civil Engineering and Software Systems.
universities.englishRequirementSummary: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90. No tuition fees! Only semester contribution ~320 EUR.

programs.title: M.Sc. Mechanical Engineering / Production Systems
programs.notes: GRE General test is mandatory for non-EU applicants. Strict subject-matching catalog.

universities.name: The University of Manchester
universities.description: Prestigious Russell Group university in England, offering world-class research, industry links, and high graduate employability.
universities.englishRequirementSummary: IELTS 6.5 - 7.0 (no band less than 6.0) or PTE 65-70.

programs.title: M.Sc. Finance
programs.notes: Accepts 4-year Bachelor degrees from recognized Pakistani institutions (HEC tier 1/2).

programs.title: M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence
programs.notes: Strong programming background in Python, Java, or C++ required.

universities.name: Politecnico di Milano
universities.description: Italy's top technical university, globally ranked #7 in Design and #18 in Engineering. Extremely affordable with DSU scholarships.
universities.englishRequirementSummary: IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 78 minimum. Low tuition (~3,900 EUR max, usually reduced to ~180 EUR with ISEE Parificato).
universities.verificationSource: Polimi International Prospective Students Portal & Universitaly

programs.title: M.Sc. Computer Science and Engineering
programs.notes: Eligible for DSU Regional scholarship which covers complete tuition waiver + 7,000 EUR cash stipend for Pakistani students.

programs.title: M.Sc. Management Engineering
programs.notes: Detailed syllabus translation and course description document required.

universities.name: University of Texas at Arlington
universities.description: Carnegie R1 Top Tier Research University in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. High STEM OPT placement and in-state tuition waiver opportunities.
universities.englishRequirementSummary: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 79 or Duolingo 110. GRE waiver available for select GPA brackets.

programs.title: M.S. Computer Science
programs.notes: Qualifies for 36-month STEM OPT in the US. Graduate assistantships grant Texas in-state tuition rate (~50% discount).

universities.name: Middle East Technical University (METU)
universities.description: Turkey's premier public research university, teaching 100% in English. High historical brotherly bond with Pakistan, very low fees and living costs.
universities.englishRequirementSummary: METU EPE exam or TOEFL IBT 79+. IELTS not accepted for Turkish national accreditation (TOEFL preferred).

programs.title: M.Sc. Electrical and Electronics Engineering
programs.notes: GRE Quantitative score minimum 155 or ALES required. High visa success rate for Pakistanis.

universities.name: The University of Melbourne
universities.description: Australia's #1 ranked university and Group of Eight member. Generous post-study work rights and high quality of life.
universities.verificationSource: Study University of Melbourne International Guide

programs.title: Master of Information Systems
programs.notes: Genuine Student (GS) assessment required for Subclass 500 visa. OSHC mandatory.

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarship (UK Government)
scholarships.academicCriteria: Equivalent to UK upper second-class 2:1 honours (typically 3.0+ CGPA in Pakistan). Minimum 2 years (2,800 hours) work or volunteer experience.
scholarships.description: The UK government's flagship global scholarship program for future leaders. Covers full university tuition fees, monthly living allowance, return economy flights, and arrival grants.
requiredDocuments: Three master course choices at UK universities
Four leadership essays (Leadership, Networking, Studying in UK, Career Plan)

scholarships.name: DAAD EPOS (Development-Related Postgraduate Courses)
scholarships.academicCriteria: Bachelor degree completed not older than 6 years. At least 2 years of relevant professional work experience after graduation.
scholarships.officialSource: DAAD Portal Germany & DAAD Information Center Islamabad
scholarships.description: Fully funded postgraduate scholarships for candidates from developing nations (including Pakistan). Monthly stipend of 934 EUR for master or 1,300 EUR for PhD, health insurance, and travel allowance.
requiredDocuments: Hand-signed Letter of Motivation with reference to current job
Proof of at least 2 years work experience

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (USEFP Pakistan)
scholarships.provider: US Department of State & USEFP Pakistan
scholarships.academicCriteria: Minimum 4-year Bachelor degree (for Master) or MPhil/MS (for PhD) from an HEC-recognized university. GRE General score mandatory.
scholarships.officialSource: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
scholarships.description: The largest Fulbright program in the world, funded by the US Government specifically for Pakistani citizens. Covers full tuition, textbooks, airfare, a living stipend, and health insurance. J-1 visa requires 2-year home residency return.

scholarships.name: Türkiye Bursları Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB)
scholarships.academicCriteria: Minimum 70% academic achievement for Bachelor, 75% for Master & PhD, 90% for Health Sciences.
scholarships.description: All-inclusive government scholarship covering university placement, 1-year Turkish language course, monthly stipend, university tuition, accommodation, health insurance, and one-time flight ticket.
requiredDocuments: National exam / Board results / University transcripts
Letter of intent and research proposal (for Master/PhD)

scholarships.name: Italian DSU Regional Scholarship (Right to Study)
scholarships.provider: Italian Regional Authorities (Lombardy, Emilia Romagna, Lazio, etc.)
scholarships.academicCriteria: Need-based financial assessment using 'ISEE Parificato' (equivalent family income under ~25,000 EUR/year) + university enrollment merit credits.
scholarships.description: Regional Italian government scholarship providing free university canteen meals, university residence or accommodation contribution (~3,000 EUR), and direct cash stipend up to ~7,500 EUR per year, plus 100% tuition tax exemption.
requiredDocuments: Family Income Certificate from Pakistan (translated & legalized by Italian Embassy)
Property / Real Estate document of family home in Pakistan
Bank balance certificate of all family members as of Dec 31
CAF legal calculation of ISEE Parificato in Italy

visaTemplates.visaType: National Visa - Type D (Study / Master / Bachelor)
visaTemplates.embassyInPakistan: German Embassy Islamabad & German Consulate General Karachi
visaTemplates.appointmentSystem: Online waiting list system via diplo.de portal. Category A for high GPA/DAAD scholars (faster); Category B for standard applicants (wait times 6-12 months).
visaTemplates.financialRequirementDesc: Mandatory German Blocked Account (Sperrkonto) with 11,208 EUR per year (approx. 3.3 - 3.5 Million PKR depending on currency rate).
visaTemplates.blockedAccountProvider: Fintiba, Expatrio, Coracle, or Deutsche Bank
visaTemplates.pakistanSpecificNotes: CRITICAL: APS (Akademische Prüfstelle) Certificate is now mandatory for Pakistani students before applying for a student visa! The certificate verifies Pakistani HEC-recognized degrees and transcripts. Book your appointment slot early as waiting times can be long.

keyChecklistItems.title: Valid Passport
keyChecklistItems.desc: Signed, at least 2 blank pages, valid for at least 12 months beyond intended stay.

keyChecklistItems.title: APS Certificate Pakistan
keyChecklistItems.desc: Original APS certificate issued by APS Islamabad verifying authenticity of academic records.

keyChecklistItems.title: University Admission Letter (Zulassungsbescheid)
keyChecklistItems.desc: Unconditional or conditional admission letter in an English- or German-taught study program.

keyChecklistItems.title: Proof of Financial Resources (Blocked Account)
keyChecklistItems.desc: Confirmation letter of Sperrkonto funded with min. 11,208 EUR or official formal obligation (Verpflichtungserklärung).

keyChecklistItems.title: Incoming Health Insurance (Incoming-Versicherung)
keyChecklistItems.desc: Valid from date of arrival until registration with statutory German health insurance (TK/Barmer/AOK).

keyChecklistItems.title: HEC & IBCC Attested Academic Degrees
keyChecklistItems.desc: Original Matric/FSc and Bachelor transcripts attested by IBCC and HEC Pakistan with stamp & QR code.

keyChecklistItems.title: Curriculum Vitae (CV) & Motivation Letter
keyChecklistItems.desc: Chronological Europass CV without gaps, plus a 1-2 page genuine statement explaining why Germany and this specific university.

keyChecklistItems.title: Proof of Language Proficiency
keyChecklistItems.desc: IELTS/TOEFL for English-taught degrees, or Goethe/TestDaF certificate for German-taught degrees.

visaTemplates.embassyInPakistan: British High Commission Islamabad (Biometrics via VFS Global Islamabad/Lahore/Karachi/Mirpur)
visaTemplates.appointmentSystem: Apply online at Gov.uk, pay Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) + visa fee, book VFS Global biometrics appointment.
visaTemplates.financialRequirementDesc: Course fees for first year + 9,207 GBP (outside London) or 12,006 GBP (inside London) held in a recognized bank account for a consecutive 28-day period.
visaTemplates.pakistanSpecificNotes: Tuberculosis (TB) test certificate must only be from an approved IOM (International Organization for Migration) clinic in Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, or Mirpur. 28-day bank maintenance rule must be strictly followed without dropping below the threshold for even one day.

keyChecklistItems.title: Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS)
keyChecklistItems.desc: 14-digit electronic CAS reference number issued by the UK university.

keyChecklistItems.title: 28-Day Bank Statement & Bank Letter
keyChecklistItems.desc: Personal or parent's bank statement showing total tuition + living expenses maintained for 28 consecutive days before application.

keyChecklistItems.title: Parental Consent & Birth Certificate (If using parent funds)
keyChecklistItems.desc: Affidavit of financial sponsorship, FRC/Birth certificate proving relationship, and consent letter.

keyChecklistItems.title: IOM Tuberculosis (TB) Medical Certificate
keyChecklistItems.desc: Valid clearance certificate issued by IOM Pakistan.

keyChecklistItems.title: ATAS Clearance Certificate (if applicable)
keyChecklistItems.desc: Academic Technology Approval Scheme clearance if studying sensitive STEM/Nuclear/Aerospace subjects.

keyChecklistItems.title: English Language Qualifications
keyChecklistItems.desc: IELTS for UKVI (SELT) or degree qualification listed on CAS.

visaTemplates.embassyInPakistan: US Embassy Islamabad & US Consulate General Karachi
visaTemplates.appointmentSystem: Complete Form DS-160 online, pay MRV fee via Allied Bank or online, schedule biometrics & consular interview on ustraveldocs.com.
visaTemplates.financialRequirementDesc: Proof of immediate liquid funds (bank statement, sponsor affidavit I-134, scholarship letter) covering the full 1-year total estimate on Form I-20.
visaTemplates.pakistanSpecificNotes: The F-1 visa interview in Islamabad/Karachi is oral and fast-paced (typically 2-4 minutes). The Consular Officer looks for strong academic intention, genuine non-immigrant intent (INA 214b ties to Pakistan), and verified financial sponsorship.

keyChecklistItems.title: Form I-20 issued by SEVP-certified school
keyChecklistItems.desc: Signed Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status.

keyChecklistItems.title: SEVIS I-901 Fee Payment Receipt ($350)
keyChecklistItems.desc: Proof of payment on fmjfee.com before attending visa interview.

keyChecklistItems.title: DS-160 Barcode Confirmation Page
keyChecklistItems.desc: Confirmation printout of online nonimmigrant visa application.

keyChecklistItems.title: Bank Statements & Source of Income
keyChecklistItems.desc: Original bank statements, tax returns (FBR Active Taxpayer), salary slips, and affidavit of support.

keyChecklistItems.title: Academic Transcripts, Degrees & Standardized Tests
keyChecklistItems.desc: Bachelor transcripts, GRE/GMAT scorecards, TOEFL/IELTS test reports.

visaTemplates.immigrationAuthority: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAECI) & Universitaly
visaTemplates.embassyInPakistan: Embassy of Italy in Islamabad & Consulate General in Karachi
visaTemplates.appointmentSystem: Online pre-enrolment via Universitaly.it, followed by legalization of educational documents and visa appointment via Gerry's / BLS / Embassy portal.
visaTemplates.financialRequirementDesc: Proof of economic sustenance of approx. 6,000 EUR (~1.8 Million PKR) plus return flight ticket and accommodation proof.
visaTemplates.pakistanSpecificNotes: Requires pre-enrolment validation on Universitaly portal. Academic transcripts must be attested by MOFA Pakistan and then legalized by Italian Embassy or verified through CIMEA Comparability & Verification Statement.

keyChecklistItems.title: Universitaly Pre-enrolment Summary (Form A)
keyChecklistItems.desc: Validated pre-enrolment summary confirmed by the Italian University.

keyChecklistItems.title: Declaration of Value (DoV) or CIMEA Statement
keyChecklistItems.desc: Document proving equivalency of Pakistani degree in the Italian educational framework.

keyChecklistItems.title: Financial Guarantee (Bank Account / DSU Award)
keyChecklistItems.desc: Bank statement showing at least 6,000 EUR in student or parent account with proof of regular family income.

keyChecklistItems.title: Proof of Accommodation in Italy
keyChecklistItems.desc: University dorm contract, host invitation (Dichiarazione di Ospitalità), or hotel booking for 30 days.

keyChecklistItems.title: International Health Insurance
keyChecklistItems.desc: Policy covering emergency hospitalization and repatriation expenses with min. 30,000 EUR coverage.

student-demo-pk-1.title: Complete Academic & Budget Profile
student-demo-pk-1.description: Fill in your exact CGPA, degree title, Pakistani university, and annual PKR budget on AbroadPilot.

subtasks.title: Confirm CGPA and maximum grading scale
Set realistic tuition and living cost ceiling in PKR
Define target degree level and subject majors

student-demo-pk-1.title: Evaluate Target Countries & Work Rights
student-demo-pk-1.description: Compare Germany with alternate destinations regarding post-study work visa rights, cost of living, and language barriers.

subtasks.title: Check tuition fee policies (free in Germany/low in Italy vs high in UK/US)
Review post-study work visa duration (e.g. 18 months for Germany, 2 yrs for UK)
Calculate currency exchange impact on PKR budget

student-demo-pk-1.title: Select 3 Reach, 3 Target, and 2 Safe Universities
student-demo-pk-1.description: Use the Discover tool to filter verified programs matching your CGPA and English language level.

subtasks.title: Review official program prerequisites and credit requirements
Compare tuition and living expenses side-by-side
Check intake deadlines (Winter / Fall)

student-demo-pk-1.title: Apply for Destination & Government Scholarships
student-demo-pk-1.description: Prepare applications for fully funded opportunities (DAAD EPOS, Chevening, Fulbright, or DSU Regional).

subtasks.title: Review eligibility criteria and document checklists
Request 2 academic/professional recommendation letters
Draft targeted scholarship personal statement

student-demo-pk-1.title: Initiate HEC & IBCC Attestation / APS Certificate
student-demo-pk-1.description: Ensure all educational degrees from Matric to Bachelor have original seals and QR codes from Pakistani verification boards.

subtasks.title: Get Matric and FSc attested from IBCC
Get Bachelor transcripts and degree attested online via HEC e-portal
Submit dossier to APS Islamabad (mandatory for Germany)
Upload scanned copies to AbroadPilot Document Vault

student-demo-pk-1.title: Submit Direct University Online Applications
student-demo-pk-1.description: Complete university portal submissions (Uni-Assist, direct portals, or UCAS) before deadline cut-offs.

subtasks.title: Upload tailored Statement of Purpose (SOP)
Submit verified English test scores (IELTS/PTE)
Pay application evaluation fees where required
Record application reference number in Applications Tracker

student-demo-pk-1.title: Evaluate Offer Letters & Accept Primary Admission
student-demo-pk-1.description: Review conditions (conditional vs unconditional), pay seat confirmation deposit if applicable, and receive formal enrollment certificate.

subtasks.title: Compare total cost and scholarships across received offers
Accept primary university offer before confirmation deadline
Request CAS (UK), I-20 (US), or Zulassungsbescheid (Germany)

student-demo-pk-1.title: Fund Blocked Account / 28-day Bank & Attend Embassy Visa Interview
student-demo-pk-1.description: Gather visa checklist items, complete embassy application forms, and prepare for oral consular questions.

subtasks.title: Open & fund blocked account (or maintain 28-day bank balance)
Book visa appointment slot at Embassy / VFS / Gerry's
Obtain travel health insurance and TB test clearance (if UK)
Practice visa interview questions using AI Visa Coach

student-demo-pk-1.title: Secure Student Accommodation & Flight Tickets
student-demo-pk-1.description: Reserve student dorm (Studentenwerk / private hall) and purchase one-way flight from Pakistan.

subtasks.title: Apply for university housing or flat-share (WG / Zoopla)
Book international flight ticket with student baggage allowance
Pack essentials, winter clothing, and attested original documents

student-demo-pk-1.title: City Registration (Anmeldung) & University Matriculation
student-demo-pk-1.description: Register your address at local city hall, open local bank account, activate health insurance, and attend campus orientation.

subtasks.title: Complete city hall resident registration upon landing
Activate local student bank account and blocked account payouts
Finalize university in-person enrollment and collect student ID
